c.st: Ask HN: Most effective way to reduce excessive digital media consumption?
c.x:
Some ideas.

Delete any accounts you have with these services.

When you’re home, put your phone away, don’t carry it on you.

Read the book “How to break up with your phone” by Catherine Anne Price.

Have one or two books that every time you are tempted to go to one of those services you pick up and read that book instead.

Meditate. Exercise. Do gardening.

BUT ultimately… figure out the root cause of your addiction and work on that.

c.st: Persuade xor Discover

Reading this reminded me of Ellis and Harper's concept of Core Irrational Beliefs, from their book "A Guide to Rational Living" (http://books.google.com/books?id=3JB9sLEV-SoC&dq=isbn:0879800429):

"Everyone I meet must treat me just the way I like; otherwise, they are completely worthless!"

The key, of course, is to recognize when you're reacting to those kinds of mental triggers and change your attitude and manner accordingly (which is easier said than done).
